content.stem: If $3x + 8 = 29$, what is the value of $x$?
content.explanation: Subtract 8 from both sides: $3x = 21$. Divide both sides by 3: $x = 7$.

distractorRationales.label: A
distractorRationales.text: This divides 29 by 3 without first subtracting 8.

distractorRationales.label: C
distractorRationales.text: This is the value of $3x$, not $x$.

distractorRationales.label: D
distractorRationales.text: This adds 8 to 29 instead of subtracting it.
